Webhooks are a way to get notified when something happens in Kaido Publish via
 an HTTP request.

faq_am_i_going_to_be_charged_by_postiz: Am I going to be charged by Kaido Publish?
faq_to_confirm_credit_card_information_p: To confirm credit card information Kaido Publish will hold $2 and release it immediately, you can cancel your subscription anytime from settings without talking to a person
faq_postiz_gitroom_is_proudly_open_sourc: Kaido Publish is proudly open-source! We believe in an ethical and transparent culture, meaning that Kaido Publish will live forever. You can check out the entire code or use it for personal projects. To view the open-source repository, click here.
faq_postiz_gitroom_allows_you_to_schedul:
Kaido Publish allows you to schedule your posts between different channels.
A channel is a publishing platform where you can schedule your posts.
For example, you can schedule your posts on X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Linkedin, Dribbble, Threads and Pinterest.
billing_postiz_grow_social: Plan, review and publish every post in one place
agent_welcome_message:
Hello, I am your Kaido Publish agent 🙌🏻.

I can schedule a post or multiple posts to multiple channels and generate pictures and videos.

You can select the channels you want to use from the left menu.

You can see your previous conversations from the right menu.

You can also use me as an MCP Server, check Settings >> Agents
farcaster_approve_instructions: Scan the QR code with your phone, or open the link on your phone, then approve Kaido Publish in the Farcaster app.
farcaster_scan_instructions: Scan the QR code with your phone, or copy the link and open it on your phone, then approve Kaido Publish in the Farcaster app.
sign_in_no_api_key: Sign in with Kaido Publish (no API key)
oauth_sign_in_hint: Your agent will open a browser window to sign in to Kaido Publish.
api_onboarding_description: Use the Kaido Publish API from your own code, n8n or any other automation
chat_onboarding_description: No MCP or CLI settings needed. Paste this into the chat, the agent installs the Kaido Publish CLI and asks you for your API key.
connector_onboarding_description: The fastest way: add Kaido Publish with one click, you will be asked to sign in
connector_self_hosted_description: The official connector works with self-hosted Kaido Publish too. When asked to sign in, choose "Use self-hosted" and enter {{url}} with your API key.
mcp_onboarding_description: Give your agent Kaido Publish tools to create, schedule and manage posts
cli_onboarding_description: Install the Kaido Publish CLI and the skill that teaches your agent how to use it
watch_tutorial_title: Learn How to Use Kaido Publish
watch_tutorial_description: Watch this short video to learn how to get the most out of Kaido Publish
kaido_auth_plan_text: One calendar for every brand and channel. Move dates, keep drafts, reuse posts.
kaido_auth_review_text: Before each post you see the preview, the account and every setting. Settings a platform requires cannot be skipped.
kaido_auth_publish_text: At the scheduled time the post goes out through the platform’s official API. The status shows up in the calendar.
